name: ekub-hub
description: Modern ekub (rotating savings) management — Next.js client + NestJS server

scripts.setup: cd server && npm install && npm run seed && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: cd server && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run start:server" "npm run start:client"
